+  "payload": "# W18 — Tabler save-feedback integration completed\n\nThe Fieldnotes settings application now uses the selected Tabler action-bearing Toast for real browser-local save feedback. Pending, success, failure/retry and validation states are connected to the existing authoritative store. The implementation and final visual review are complete within the supplied scope and tested conditions.\n\n## Run the product\n\nFrom `/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w18/app`:\n\n```bash\npython3 -m http.server 4418 --bind 127.0.0.1\n```\n\nOpen [the light/English application](http://127.0.0.1:4418/?theme=light&lang=en) or [the dark/Chinese application](http://127.0.0.1:4418/?theme=dark&lang=zh). Add `&fail=once` on a new load to exercise the forced failure, or call `window.fieldnotes.setFailureMode(true)` before saving. No build or install is required. The inspection server is stopped at handover; the application remains runnable with this command.\n\n## What changed\n\n| Product file | Bounded change | Diff |\n|---|---|---|\n| `app/index.html` | Adopted the exact native toast shell in the prescribed utility container; kept the inline summary quiet to avoid a second live announcement | +19 / −1 lines |\n| `app/settings-controller.js` | Coordinates authoritative events, pending controls, field errors, draft-aware summary and visible focus recovery | +68 / −4 lines |\n| `app/save-notification.js` | New adapter for native Toast rendering, localized feedback, exact-snapshot retry, stale-event protection and dismissal focus | +69 lines |\n\nNo dependency or custom CSS rule was added. The store, source preview and 35 tracked protected source/asset files remain byte-identical. The existing MIT license and adopted-block attribution are retained. The exact final comparison is in [product-changes.diff](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w18/evidence/product-changes.diff).\n\nSuccess wording follows an actual successful storage write and displays its saved time. Failure preserves both the previous stored value and current form edits. Retry saves the failed submission's snapshot, while a later draft remains in the fields. Toast completion does not steal form focus. Close dismisses only the feedback, and a later authoritative event can replace it. Validation uses the store's actual errors and names the first invalid field in both languages.\n\n## Verification and the repair it prompted\n\nThe six required conditions—1440×900, 1280×600 and 390×844, each in light/English and dark/Chinese—passed 180 assertions covering save, pending edits, success, forced failure, retry, validation, close, storage readback, reload, theme controls, announcements and containment. A supplemental sequence verified that an older error cannot replace a newer invalid result and that dismissing pending feedback does not cancel the write.\n\nA later independent keyboard/visual check exposed a real issue missed by DOM-focus assertions: on a narrow screen the first invalid field could be focused at y=0 behind the toast. I repaired only the controller's recovery scrolling. All six conditions then passed fresh Tab traversal, dismissal return, invalid-field visibility and header-return checks, and I personally opened the repaired screenshots. The field now appears visibly centered below the toast. See [the failed observation](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w18/evidence/keyboard-final-02/light-en-settled-invalid.png) and [the repaired narrow view](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w18/evidence/keyboard-final-03/390x844-light-en-settled-invalid.png).\n\nThe corrected storage-exception probe confirms that an actual thrown storage write preserves the previous value, and retry succeeds after storage is restored without overwriting newer form edits. Persistent feedback remained visible beyond the native default timeout. Final JavaScript syntax and source digests passed.\n\nOriginal command failures are retained. The first broad command ended with a supplemental test-harness error after its six matrix cases had passed; the corrected probe is separate. A premature evidence-packaging attempt also failed while waiting for the subsequently repaired keyboard result. These failures are not relabeled as successful runs. [verification-summary.json](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w18/evidence/verification-summary.json) identifies the actual exports and their boundaries.\n\n## Source craft and visual findings\n\nThe integration retains the source's 350 px width, native type, header/body grouping, border, shadow, padding, small primary button and separated action row. English and Chinese states fit at the narrow width; the lower settings actions remain reachable. I personally inspected the supplied standalone source, the acquired original-page rendering, integrated whole-page views, source detail, ordered state frames and repaired validation views. [VISUAL-REVIEW.md](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w18/VISUAL-REVIEW.md) records the observations and their limits.\n\nRepresentative final views:\n\n- [Desktop, light/English error](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w18/evidence/final-inspection/1440x900-light-en-error-top.png)\n- [Short viewport, dark/Chinese with lower controls](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w18/evidence/final-inspection/1280x600-dark-zh-error-lower.png)\n- [Narrow viewport, dark/Chinese error](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w18/evidence/final-inspection/390x844-dark-zh-error-top.png)\n- [Repaired narrow Chinese validation](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w18/evidence/keyboard-final-03/390x844-dark-zh-settled-invalid.png)\n\n**The prescribed placement has a visible tradeoff:** while open, the toast overlaps some upper-right header utilities and much of the narrow header/title area. The native close control stays reachable, and dismissal restores the header. I preserved this settled composition and reported the overlap rather than choosing a new placement.\n\n## Evidence and limits\n\nThe three supplied HTML/block hashes match [SOURCE-MANIFEST.json](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w18/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json). The related tag remains `@tabler/core@1.7.1`, commit `07f60c07da13d8ff957a370434b7ef5c86f5ab94`; the deployed snapshot's exact deployment commit remains unadvertised.\n\nLive public-demo navigation failed TLS verification. I retained the failure and rendered the exact acquired upstream HTML locally with matching assets; this is not a claim of live public-site inspection. Temporal evidence consists of real-time automated actions and personally viewed, timestamped ordered frames. Natural-speed playback and actual screen-reader speech were not inspected. Unrelated upstream gallery routes remain outside the task contract.\n\nThis package was implemented directly, with no additional package child and no merge step. The observed product rework was one focused visibility repair; evidence collection also required the documented harness/capture corrections. No sibling package or other agent result was inspected, so no comparative productivity or billed-cost claim is made. Backend identity, token totals and billed cost are unknown.\n\nThe runnable source, exact diff, source identities, test scripts, failed and successful command outputs, browser-state logs, actual image-tool responses and final captures are retained in this package. Design judgment is recorded separately from test success and end-user acceptance."

+# Fieldnotes settings: completed save-feedback integration
+
+The assigned T4 integration is complete. The existing settings application now uses the selected native Tabler toast for pending, saved, failed and invalid outcomes, with explicit retry of the failed snapshot and preserved newer edits.
+
+## Run the application
+
+No build or dependency installation is required.
+
+```bash
+cd /workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w17/app
+python3 -m http.server 4417 --bind 127.0.0.1
+```
+
+Open [the light English view](http://127.0.0.1:4417/?theme=light&lang=en) or [the dark Chinese view](http://127.0.0.1:4417/?theme=dark&lang=zh). Add `&fail=once` to exercise a one-time save failure and Retry. The dedicated verification server was stopped after testing, as required.
+
+## What changed
+
+| Product file | Result |
+| --- | --- |
+| [index.html](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w17/app/index.html) | Adopts the native action-bearing toast, its full MIT notice, the prescribed top-right container and associated Tabler field-error slots. |
+| [settings-controller.js](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w17/app/settings-controller.js) | Coordinates store events, concise form summaries, actual field errors, focus recovery and stale-result suppression. |
+| [save-notification.js](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w17/app/save-notification.js) | Renders the authoritative save states and retries the exact failed snapshot through the existing store. |
+
+A successful save reports the actual browser-local outcome and saved time. It leaves later edits in the form and marks those edits as unsaved. A failed write preserves the previous stored value and the draft. Retry saves the failed version explicitly. Dismissal changes only feedback; it does not cancel persistence or discard input. Invalid submissions identify the actual first invalid field and expose associated localized errors.
+
+The source's 350px shell, avatar/identity/time/close header, body spacing, separated error action, small primary button, typography, border, shadow and native Toast transitions remain intact. The frozen placement and source choice were retained. The [source manifest](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w17/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json) preserves Tabler 1.7.1, the tagged revision and the separate deployed HTML snapshot identity; the deployment commit remains unknown.

A separate reduced-motion run reached a saved result with the native toast transition measured at `0s`.

+# Main-agent visual review — Fieldnotes save feedback
+
+## Judgment and boundary
+
+The settled T4 save-feedback integration is complete within the assigned edit surface. I independently inspected the selected source before delegation, reviewed the actual code, exercised the integrated application, and personally opened the final assembled screenshots. The native Tabler visual relationships survive the integration. Source selection, placement and the surrounding page were inherited from INTEGRATION-DECISION.md; no new art direction or original-construction exception was introduced.
+
+This is main-agent design judgment for the bounded integration. It is not a claim of end-user aesthetic approval, a live screen-reader audit, real-device touch validation, or whole-gallery completion. Two visible limits remain below.
+
+## Conditions and subjects
+
+The actual browser was Chromium headless shell 143.0.7499.4 through local Python Playwright, with device scale factor 1 and the prescribed Noto CJK Fontconfig file. The evaluated combinations were 1440×900, 1280×600 and 390×844, each in light/en and dark/zh.
+
+I kept these subjects distinct:
+- The exact acquired official HTML, locally rendered and operated through its original Cookies toast trigger.
+- The supplied isolated source block rendering.
+- The unchanged prepared Fieldnotes settings page.
+- The actual integrated page and browser-local save flow.
+
+The public deployed source reports 1.7.1, while the related tagged source is revision `07f60c07da13d8ff957a370434b7ef5c86f5ab94`. The deployed snapshot's exact commit remains unknown. Original snapshots and their digests are preserved; the current live upstream page was used only as textual source context.
+
+## Whole surface, relationships and detail
+
+At 1440×900 the form retains its sidebar, account heading, profile controls and three-field row. At 1280×600 the shorter viewport requires ordinary document scrolling, and the fixed feedback remains available while the lower Save and Cancel controls are reached. At 390×844 the inherited one-column form and stacked settings navigation remain intact. Initial card, heading, display-name field and Save-button geometry exactly matched the captured baseline in all six combinations.
+
+The adopted toast retains the 350px source width, compact avatar/identity/time/close header, bordered body, subtle shadow and separated error action row. FN uses the source initials fallback; Fieldnotes supplies the identity. There is no new surface CSS. Error uses the native small primary action. Pending, success and invalid hide the action row, preserving the source body measure.
+
+English copy wraps into two lines for error and pending; Chinese copy also wraps without clipping. The dark view keeps the source's dark header/body distinction and visible thin separator. The native close target is reachable in every required viewport. Source and integrated computed width, type, radius, border, shadow and header/body padding matched in the integrator's explicit check; my own code and pixel review established that the preserved classes actually appear in the assembled product.
+
+Validation uses the existing Tabler field-error treatment. The first invalid display-name field is brought into view, visible messages remain next to the empty name and malformed email, and both languages name the first field in the notification. At the mobile viewport the invalid field remains below the fixed toast rather than being hidden by it.
+
+## Actual views opened by the main agent
+
+Original full image-tool responses are in `evidence/views/`; `evidence/viewed-images.json` provides the exact input paths and receipt identities.
+
+Source/baseline: `evidence/captures/source-1440.png`, `baseline-1440.png`, and `acquired-source-1440.png`.
+
+For **each** prefix below, I personally opened all three settled images in `evidence/integrator/004-settled/`: `-error-top.png`, `-error-actions.png`, and `-invalid.png`.

+
+I also personally opened the main run's pending, success and retry-pending captures for both 1440 variants; the first integration error/invalid captures; the two unchanged mobile baseline Save-edge images; and the reduced-motion success image.
+
+## Static, controlled and natural-time evidence
+
+The 18 final settled integrator images explicitly wait for the native `showing` class to clear and use instant scrolling. Their capture brackets, viewport, scroll position, state and focus are in `004-settled/captures.json`. These support static appearance and contextual placement judgments.
+
+The main run used the store's real 750 ms timer and actual UI controls. Ordered captures in `evidence/main-check-002/` have actual page-clock capture brackets in `report.json`. The first pending screenshots sampled the start of the native fade before the toast was visible; these are retained as early-time observations. Retry-pending captures show the existing visible toast update in place, its action row removed, and focus restored to the editable display-name field. Success captures show the saved-time header while the newer draft and its unsaved-form summary remain visible.
+
+These sampled images and executed natural-timer interactions do **not** establish uninterrupted natural-speed animation smoothness. Two actual WebM recordings are retained but were not viewed as continuous playback. No claim of natural-time playback inspection, device-wide frame delivery or user-perceived latency is made. The main report's event-history arrays reset on page reload; the executed assertions, capture brackets, actual storage readbacks and original command output remain the evidence for those checks.
+
+A separate reduced-motion run exercised failure → keyboard retry → actual saved result and measured a native toast transition duration of `0s`. The resulting dark/Chinese success image was personally viewed.
+
+## Verified behavior
+
+The main independent matrix passed **203 assertions**: six required conditions plus the older-result/dismiss-pending stress. All six had zero JavaScript page errors. The checks include real storage readback, retained newer drafts, retry of the failed snapshot, native close preserving storage, first-error focus, associated field messages, non-duplicating status semantics, reload persistence, initial layout retention and toast containment.
+
+The scoped integrator separately passed **156 assertions**, including extended length validation, no auto-hide after 5.2 seconds, and additional real concurrent-operation cases. That result supports its specified checks; it did not substitute for the main agent's independent run or pixel review.
+
+## Visible limits retained with evidence
+
+### Prescribed top-right placement overlays header utilities
+
+At desktop sizes, the notification covers the right notification, app, language and user menu controls. At 390px it also covers the center of the primary-navigation toggle and the logo/user region. The native close remains directly reachable. After native dismissal and returning to the top, every sampled header control's center is reachable again.
+
+This is the observable consequence of the exact settled placement. I retained that explicit design decision and recorded the tradeoff; I do not claim the underlying header remains simultaneously pointer-accessible while the toast is displayed. Changing placement would reopen the frozen decision.
+
+### Inherited mobile Customize/Save overlap
+
+At 390×844, when Save is aligned at the viewport bottom, the unchanged floating Customize button covers part of Save's right edge. I independently rendered the preserved baseline and integrated page in both languages. The Save rectangles and hit results were identical: its center is reachable; the sampled upper-right point is covered. Keyboard activation also passed.

+# W18 — Tabler save-feedback integration completed
+
+The Fieldnotes settings application now uses the selected Tabler action-bearing Toast for real browser-local save feedback. Pending, success, failure/retry and validation states are connected to the existing authoritative store. The implementation and final visual review are complete within the supplied scope and tested conditions.
+
+## Run the product
+
+From `/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w18/app`:
+
+```bash
+python3 -m http.server 4418 --bind 127.0.0.1
+```
+
+Open [the light/English application](http://127.0.0.1:4418/?theme=light&lang=en) or [the dark/Chinese application](http://127.0.0.1:4418/?theme=dark&lang=zh). Add `&fail=once` on a new load to exercise the forced failure, or call `window.fieldnotes.setFailureMode(true)` before saving. No build or install is required. The inspection server is stopped at handover; the application remains runnable with this command.
+
+## What changed
+
+| Product file | Bounded change | Diff |
+|---|---|---|
+| `app/index.html` | Adopted the exact native toast shell in the prescribed utility container; kept the inline summary quiet to avoid a second live announcement | +19 / −1 lines |
+| `app/settings-controller.js` | Coordinates authoritative events, pending controls, field errors, draft-aware summary and visible focus recovery | +68 / −4 lines |
+| `app/save-notification.js` | New adapter for native Toast rendering, localized feedback, exact-snapshot retry, stale-event protection and dismissal focus | +69 lines |
+
+No dependency or custom CSS rule was added. The store, source preview and 35 tracked protected source/asset files remain byte-identical. The existing MIT license and adopted-block attribution are retained. The exact final comparison is in [product-changes.diff](artifacts/evidence/product-changes.diff.txt).
+
+Success wording follows an actual successful storage write and displays its saved time. Failure preserves both the previous stored value and current form edits. Retry saves the failed submission's snapshot, while a later draft remains in the fields. Toast completion does not steal form focus. Close dismisses only the feedback, and a later authoritative event can replace it. Validation uses the store's actual errors and names the first invalid field in both languages.
+
+## Verification and the repair it prompted
+
+The six required conditions—1440×900, 1280×600 and 390×844, each in light/English and dark/Chinese—passed 180 assertions covering save, pending edits, success, forced failure, retry, validation, close, storage readback, reload, theme controls, announcements and containment. A supplemental sequence verified that an older error cannot replace a newer invalid result and that dismissing pending feedback does not cancel the write.
+
+A later independent keyboard/visual check exposed a real issue missed by DOM-focus assertions: on a narrow screen the first invalid field could be focused at y=0 behind the toast. I repaired only the controller's recovery scrolling. All six conditions then passed fresh Tab traversal, dismissal return, invalid-field visibility and header-return checks, and I personally opened the repaired screenshots. The field now appears visibly centered below the toast. See [the failed observation](artifacts/evidence/keyboard-final-02/light-en-settled-invalid.png) and [the repaired narrow view](artifacts/evidence/keyboard-final-03/390x844-light-en-settled-invalid.png).
+
+The corrected storage-exception probe confirms that an actual thrown storage write preserves the previous value, and retry succeeds after storage is restored without overwriting newer form edits. Persistent feedback remained visible beyond the native default timeout. Final JavaScript syntax and source digests passed.
+
+Original command failures are retained. The first broad command ended with a supplemental test-harness error after its six matrix cases had passed; the corrected probe is separate. A premature evidence-packaging attempt also failed while waiting for the subsequently repaired keyboard result. These failures are not relabeled as successful runs. [verification-summary.json](artifacts/evidence/verification-summary.json) identifies the actual exports and their boundaries.
+
+## Source craft and visual findings
+
+The integration retains the source's 350 px width, native type, header/body grouping, border, shadow, padding, small primary button and separated action row. English and Chinese states fit at the narrow width; the lower settings actions remain reachable. I personally inspected the supplied standalone source, the acquired original-page rendering, integrated whole-page views, source detail, ordered state frames and repaired validation views. [VISUAL-REVIEW.md](artifacts/VISUAL-REVIEW.md.txt) records the observations and their limits.

+# Visual review — W18 save feedback
+
+## Reviewer and scope
+
+The package owner personally opened the source, trial, final and repaired images using `view_image`; the original returned objects are preserved in `evidence/views/` and `evidence/source-inspection/view-*.json`. `evidence/viewed-images.json` indexes the actual viewed images. This report is professional judgment, not a native tool export or end-user aesthetic acceptance.
+
+The retained source is Tabler 1.7.1's action-bearing cookie Toast. Source identity and composition were settled by the supplied integration decision; no new resource choice or original visual exception was made. The primary task is editing and persisting browser-local settings with truthful feedback and recovery.
+
+## Source observations
+
+I read the exact extracted block and tagged Astro component, then viewed the supplied standalone source rendering in light and dark. I also operated the original Cookies toast trigger in the exact acquired full deployed HTML, rendered locally with the matching supplied assets. Its full-page image includes the entrance transition; the separately viewed toast crop is settled. This is distinct from the integrated settings application.
+
+The live public demo failed certificate verification (`ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID`); TLS checks were not weakened. The original deployed snapshot was fulfilled at a local test route, with nonlocal requests blocked. The unavailable sample portrait and cookie glyph are limitations of that source rendering, not assets shipped in the integration. The product uses the authorized FN initials fallback and no emoji.
+
+The source's value is a compact 350 px shell with a quiet identity/time/close header, readable body, and a fine separator above one small primary action. The integrated error state retains those relationships. Native computed values include 14 px body type, 20 px line height, 8×12 px header padding, 12 px body padding, 8 px action margin/padding, 6 px corner radius and the existing border/shadow. They are inherited from the unchanged assets, not replacement CSS.
+
+## Whole-product observations
+
+| Condition | Actually viewed relationship | Judgment |
+|---|---|---|
+| 1440×900, light/English and dark/Chinese | Initial composition, error toast, source detail, pending and success samples, repaired invalid state | The toast remains a compact secondary surface. The main settings hierarchy, mixed-script values, sidebar and form grouping remain intact. |
+| 1280×600, both declared variants | Error at the top and lower document position; repaired invalid states | Short height requires the inherited document scroll. Retry and close remain visible, while the lower Save/Cancel row remains unobstructed. |
+| 390×844, both declared variants | Error at top and lower positions; Chinese success; repaired invalid states; restored headers | The 350 px toast fits within the viewport at x=24…374. English and Chinese copy wrap naturally; action text and close stay within the surface. No horizontal page overflow was measured. |
+
+The prescribed top-right placement overlaps some upstream header utilities while feedback is visible; at narrow size it covers much of the header/title area. This is an observed consequence of the fixed integration decision. The native Close control remains exposed, and the restored-header views show the navigation unobscured after dismissal. I preserved the mandated placement rather than changing art direction. Settings controls and lower save actions remain usable by scrolling.
+
+## A real defect found after functional checks
+
+The first matrix verified that invalid submission moved DOM focus to Display name, but a subsequent settled narrow screenshot showed that the field was at y=0, underneath the fixed toast. This was a visible-focus defect, not a passing visual result. The failed screenshot and geometry remain in `evidence/keyboard-final-02`, and commands 011/013 retain the failed assertions.
+
+The allowed controller now uses native `scrollIntoView({block:'center', behavior:'instant'})`, then focuses with `preventScroll`. The final keyboard recheck covers all six declared conditions. The focused field now sits at y=430 at 1440×900, y=280 at 1280×600, and y=402 at 390×844, below the toast. I personally viewed all six repaired invalid-state images and the two restored narrow headers. The field label, input boundary and localized error are visible together. No source CSS, toast transition, placement or store rule changed.
+
+The real Tab sequence from Save reaches Close and Retry in nine Tab steps through the existing footer controls. Shift+Tab returns from Retry to Close; Enter dismisses; focus returns to Save. These were executed in all six final conditions, separately from programmatic focus checks.
+
+## Time, focus and state
+
+I viewed ordered pending/edit/error/retry/success samples and the later measured entrance/result frames. `evidence/temporal-01` records browser `performance.now()` brackets, native Toast events and actual operation events. Frame filename offsets are requested targets; JSON timestamps are the actual capture times. For example, the English file labelled 0400 ms was captured at approximately 617 ms because of capture overhead.
+
+Early entrance frames have the native `showing` class and opacity 0, followed by the source fade. Later pending frames are fully readable before authoritative success. The inline summary acknowledges the operation immediately. Pending and success retain the same compact height, and the lower form action remains anchored. Native focus styling remains visible on Save while its disabled presentation changes. Error adds the inherited separated action row; retry removes that row and returns focus to Save. Editing during pending and success retains the newer draft.
+
+These are real-time automated interactions plus actually viewed ordered frames, with unobserved intervals between samples. No natural-speed live or video playback was viewed, and no smoothness, frame-rate or screen-reader speech claim is made. ARIA ownership and field associations were checked structurally; actual assistive-technology output remains untested.
+
+## Current evidence applicability
+
+The broad save/retry matrix and the source/error/success views precede the narrow recovery-scroll repair. Their state, persistence, source and appearance claims remain applicable because the final delta changes only invalid-field recovery scrolling. All affected invalid-focus, keyboard and restored-header conditions were freshly rerun and viewed after that delta. Final source hashes, protected-file hashes and JavaScript syntax were rechecked after the repair.

+# Visual review — W18 save feedback
+
+## Reviewer and scope
+
+The package owner personally opened the source, trial, final and repaired images using `view_image`; the original returned objects are preserved in `evidence/views/` and `evidence/source-inspection/view-*.json`. `evidence/viewed-images.json` indexes the actual viewed images. This report is professional judgment, not a native tool export or end-user aesthetic acceptance.
+
+The retained source is Tabler 1.7.1's action-bearing cookie Toast. Source identity and composition were settled by the supplied integration decision; no new resource choice or original visual exception was made. The primary task is editing and persisting browser-local settings with truthful feedback and recovery.
+
+## Source observations
+
+I read the exact extracted block and tagged Astro component, then viewed the supplied standalone source rendering in light and dark. I also operated the original Cookies toast trigger in the exact acquired full deployed HTML, rendered locally with the matching supplied assets. Its full-page image includes the entrance transition; the separately viewed toast crop is settled. This is distinct from the integrated settings application.
+
+The live public demo failed certificate verification (`ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID`); TLS checks were not weakened. The original deployed snapshot was fulfilled at a local test route, with nonlocal requests blocked. The unavailable sample portrait and cookie glyph are limitations of that source rendering, not assets shipped in the integration. The product uses the authorized FN initials fallback and no emoji.
+
+The source's value is a compact 350 px shell with a quiet identity/time/close header, readable body, and a fine separator above one small primary action. The integrated error state retains those relationships. Native computed values include 14 px body type, 20 px line height, 8×12 px header padding, 12 px body padding, 8 px action margin/padding, 6 px corner radius and the existing border/shadow. They are inherited from the unchanged assets, not replacement CSS.
+
+## Whole-product observations
+
+| Condition | Actually viewed relationship | Judgment |
+|---|---|---|
+| 1440×900, light/English and dark/Chinese | Initial composition, error toast, source detail, pending and success samples, repaired invalid state | The toast remains a compact secondary surface. The main settings hierarchy, mixed-script values, sidebar and form grouping remain intact. |
+| 1280×600, both declared variants | Error at the top and lower document position; repaired invalid states | Short height requires the inherited document scroll. Retry and close remain visible, while the lower Save/Cancel row remains unobstructed. |
+| 390×844, both declared variants | Error at top and lower positions; Chinese success; repaired invalid states; restored headers | The 350 px toast fits within the viewport at x=24…374. English and Chinese copy wrap naturally; action text and close stay within the surface. No horizontal page overflow was measured. |
+
+The prescribed top-right placement overlaps some upstream header utilities while feedback is visible; at narrow size it covers much of the header/title area. This is an observed consequence of the fixed integration decision. The native Close control remains exposed, and the restored-header views show the navigation unobscured after dismissal. I preserved the mandated placement rather than changing art direction. Settings controls and lower save actions remain usable by scrolling.
+
+## A real defect found after functional checks
+
+The first matrix verified that invalid submission moved DOM focus to Display name, but a subsequent settled narrow screenshot showed that the field was at y=0, underneath the fixed toast. This was a visible-focus defect, not a passing visual result. The failed screenshot and geometry remain in `evidence/keyboard-final-02`, and commands 011/013 retain the failed assertions.
+
+The allowed controller now uses native `scrollIntoView({block:'center', behavior:'instant'})`, then focuses with `preventScroll`. The final keyboard recheck covers all six declared conditions. The focused field now sits at y=430 at 1440×900, y=280 at 1280×600, and y=402 at 390×844, below the toast. I personally viewed all six repaired invalid-state images and the two restored narrow headers. The field label, input boundary and localized error are visible together. No source CSS, toast transition, placement or store rule changed.
+
+The real Tab sequence from Save reaches Close and Retry in nine Tab steps through the existing footer controls. Shift+Tab returns from Retry to Close; Enter dismisses; focus returns to Save. These were executed in all six final conditions, separately from programmatic focus checks.
+
+## Time, focus and state
+
+I viewed ordered pending/edit/error/retry/success samples and the later measured entrance/result frames. `evidence/temporal-01` records browser `performance.now()` brackets, native Toast events and actual operation events. Frame filename offsets are requested targets; JSON timestamps are the actual capture times. For example, the English file labelled 0400 ms was captured at approximately 617 ms because of capture overhead.
+
+Early entrance frames have the native `showing` class and opacity 0, followed by the source fade. Later pending frames are fully readable before authoritative success. The inline summary acknowledges the operation immediately. Pending and success retain the same compact height, and the lower form action remains anchored. Native focus styling remains visible on Save while its disabled presentation changes. Error adds the inherited separated action row; retry removes that row and returns focus to Save. Editing during pending and success retains the newer draft.
+
+These are real-time automated interactions plus actually viewed ordered frames, with unobserved intervals between samples. No natural-speed live or video playback was viewed, and no smoothness, frame-rate or screen-reader speech claim is made. ARIA ownership and field associations were checked structurally; actual assistive-technology output remains untested.
+
+## Current evidence applicability
+
+The broad save/retry matrix and the source/error/success views precede the narrow recovery-scroll repair. Their state, persistence, source and appearance claims remain applicable because the final delta changes only invalid-field recovery scrolling. All affected invalid-focus, keyboard and restored-header conditions were freshly rerun and viewed after that delta. Final source hashes, protected-file hashes and JavaScript syntax were rechecked after the repair.
+

+// Tabler 1.7.1 action-toast integration. The source shell is in index.html.
+// Tabler copyright (c) 2018-2026 The Tabler Authors, MIT; see LICENSE.
+import { saveSettings } from './settings-store.js';
+
+export function createSaveNotification({ zh, returnFocus, fieldName }) {
+  const root = document.querySelector('#save-notification');
+  const message = document.querySelector('#save-notification-message');
+  const time = document.querySelector('#save-notification-time');
+  const actions = document.querySelector('#save-notification-actions');
+  const retry = document.querySelector('#retry-save');
+  const close = root.querySelector('[data-bs-dismiss="toast"]');
+  const toast = window.tabler.bootstrap.Toast.getOrCreateInstance(root, { autohide: false });
+  const formatTime = value => new Intl.DateTimeFormat(zh ? 'zh-CN' : 'en', {hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit',second:'2-digit'}).format(new Date(value));
+  let latestOperation = 0;
+  let failedSnapshot = null;
+  let hiding = false;
+  let reopen = false;
+  let restoreAfterHide = false;
+  close.setAttribute('aria-label', zh ? '关闭保存提示' : 'Close save feedback');
+  retry.textContent = zh ? '重试保存' : 'Retry save';
+
+  root.addEventListener('hide.bs.toast', () => {
+    hiding = true;
+    restoreAfterHide = root.contains(document.activeElement);
+  });
+  root.addEventListener('hidden.bs.toast', () => {
+    hiding = false;
+    if (restoreAfterHide && (root.contains(document.activeElement) || document.activeElement === document.body)) returnFocus();
+    restoreAfterHide = false;
+    if (reopen) { reopen = false; toast.show(); }
+  });
+  retry.addEventListener('click', () => {
+    if (!failedSnapshot) return;
+    // Retry exactly the submitted snapshot. Later form edits remain owned by the form.
+    const snapshot = { ...failedSnapshot };
+    saveSettings(snapshot).catch(() => {});
+  });
+
+  return {
+    render(event) {
+      if (event.operationId < latestOperation) return;
+      latestOperation = event.operationId;
+      const isError = event.status === 'error';
+      if (!isError && actions.contains(document.activeElement)) returnFocus();
+      failedSnapshot = isError ? { ...event.snapshot } : null;
+      actions.hidden = !isError;
+      root.dataset.state = event.status;
+      root.dataset.operationId = String(event.operationId);
+      time.textContent = event.savedAt ? formatTime(event.savedAt) : (zh ? '刚刚' : 'Now');
+      if (event.savedAt) time.setAttribute('title', event.savedAt); else time.removeAttribute('title');
+      const firstField = Object.keys(event.fieldErrors || {})[0];
+      const content = zh ? {
+        pending: '正在保存更改。正在将本次提交的版本保存到当前浏览器。',
+        success: '更改已保存。本次提交的版本仅保存在当前浏览器中。',
+        error: '保存未完成。草稿仍然保留。重试将保存上次提交的版本。',
+        invalid: `请检查个人资料字段：${fieldName(firstField)}。`
+      } : {
+        pending: 'Saving changes. Saving the submitted version in this browser.',
+        success: 'Changes saved. The submitted version is saved only in this browser.',
+        error: 'Save did not complete. Your draft is preserved. Retry saves the previously submitted version.',
+        invalid: `Check profile fields: ${fieldName(firstField)}.`
+      };
+      message.textContent = content[event.status];
+      if (hiding) reopen = true;
+      else if (!root.classList.contains('show')) toast.show();
+    },
+    formatTime
+  };
+}"},{"sha":"f9b728f3fd5d6bcdd8e0428067bb783608ea3ab4","filename":"docs/evidence/v1.20.0/session-study/runs/T4-G-final-runtime-r1/artifacts/app/settings-controller.js","status":"added","additions":97,"deletions":0,"changes":97,"blob_url":"https://github.com/D1ChangGeng/UI-Spec-Studio/blob/89cf94495dc1300dbb21c3f93e5972a2c67ab020/docs%2Fevidence%2Fv1.20.0%2Fsession-study%2Fruns%2FT4-G-final-runtime-r1%2Fartifacts%2Fapp%2Fsettings-controller.js","raw_url":"https://github.com/D1ChangGeng/UI-Spec-Studio/raw/89cf94495dc1300dbb21c3f93e5972a2c67ab020/docs%2Fevidence%2Fv1.20.0%2Fsession-study%2Fruns%2FT4-G-final-runtime-r1%2Fartifacts%2Fapp%2Fsettings-controller.js","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/D1ChangGeng/UI-Spec-Studio/contents/docs%2Fevidence%2Fv1.20.0%2Fsession-study%2Fruns%2FT4-G-final-runtime-r1%2Fartifacts%2Fapp%2Fsettings-controller.js?ref=89cf94495dc1300dbb21c3f93e5972a2c67ab020","patch":"@@ -0,0 +1,97 @@
+import { readSettings, saveSettings, subscribeSettings, setFailureMode } from './settings-store.js';

+const ids = {displayName:'business-name',organization:'business-id',location:'location',email:'email',weeklyDigest:'weekly-digest',publicProfile:'public-profile'};
+const status = document.querySelector('#save-status');

+const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);

+const copy = zh ? {idle:'更改仅保存在当前浏览器中。',pending:'本次提交正在保存。',error:'未写入本次提交的版本。',invalid:'请修正已标出的字段。'} : {idle:'Changes are saved only in this browser.',pending:'The submitted version is being saved.',error:'The submitted version was not written.',invalid:'Correct the marked fields.'};
+const names = zh ? {displayName:'显示名称',organization:'机构',location:'地点',email:'电子邮件'} : {displayName:'Display name',organization:'Organization',location:'Location',email:'Email'};

+let latestOperation = 0;
+let pending = false;
+let initiatingControl = save;
+function draft() { return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(ids).map(([key,id])=>{const el=document.getElementById(id);return [key,el.type==='checkbox'?el.checked:el.value];})); }
+function clearErrors() {
+  for (const id of Object.values(ids)) {
+    const field = document.getElementById(id);
+    field.classList.remove('is-invalid');
+    field.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
+    const described = (field.getAttribute('aria-describedby') || '').split(/\s+/).filter(value => value && value !== `${id}-error`);
+    if (described.length) field.setAttribute('aria-describedby', described.join(' ')); else field.removeAttribute('aria-describedby');
+    document.getElementById(`${id}-error`)?.remove();
+  }
+}
+function showErrors(fieldErrors) {
+  clearErrors();
+  for (const [key, message] of Object.entries(fieldErrors)) {
+    const field = document.getElementById(ids[key]);
+    if (!field) continue;
+    const feedback = document.createElement('div');
+    feedback.id = `${field.id}-error`;
+    feedback.className = 'invalid-feedback';
+    feedback.textContent = zh ? (errorsZh[message] || message) : message;

+    // Native focus scrolling can leave a narrow-screen field behind the fixed toast.
+    // Center the recovery target while retaining Tabler's field and toast styling.
+    first.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center', behavior: 'instant' });
+    if (document.activeElement !== first) first.focus({ preventScroll: true });
+  }
+}
+function load() { const data=readSettings(); for(const [key,id] of Object.entries(ids)){const el=document.getElementById(id); if(el.type==='checkbox')el.checked=data[key];else el.value=data[key];} }
+function returnFocus() {
+  const target = initiatingControl?.isConnected && !initiatingControl.disabled ? initiatingControl : save;
+  target.focus();
+}
+const notification = createSaveNotification({zh, returnFocus, fieldName: key => names[key] || (zh ? '个人资料' : 'Profile')});
+try { load(); status.textContent=copy.idle; } catch(error) { status.textContent=error.message; }
+subscribeSettings(event => {
+  if (event.operationId < latestOperation) return;
+  latestOperation = event.operationId;
+  pending = event.status === 'pending';
+  // Native Tabler disabled styling plus aria-disabled keeps keyboard focus stable.
+  save.classList.toggle('disabled', pending);

+  if (event.status === 'invalid') showErrors(event.fieldErrors);
+  else if (event.status === 'pending') clearErrors();

+    const changed = Object.keys(ids).some(key => draft()[key] !== event.settings[key]);
+    const savedTime = notification.formatTime(event.savedAt);
+    status.textContent = zh ? `上次保存：${savedTime}。${changed ? '之后的编辑尚未保存。' : ''}` : `Last saved: ${savedTime}.${changed ? ' Later edits are not saved yet.' : ''}`;
+  } else status.textContent = copy[event.status] || copy.idle;
+  status.dataset.state = event.status;
+  notification.render(event);
+});
+save.addEventListener('click', async () => {
+  if (pending) return;
+  initiatingControl = save;
+  try { await saveSettings(draft()); } catch {}
+});
+document.querySelector('#cancel-settings').addEventListener('click',()=>{try{load();clearErrors();status.textContent=copy.idle;status.dataset.state='idle';}catch(error){status.textContent=error.message;}});
+document.querySelector('#focus-email').addEventListener('click',()=>document.querySelector('#email').focus());

+document.querySelector('#theme-toggle').addEventListener('click',()=>{const dark=document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-bs-theme')==='dark';document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-bs-theme',dark?'light':'dark');localStorage.setItem('tabler-theme',dark?'light':'dark');});
+window.fieldnotes = { readSettings, saveSettings, setFailureMode, draft };
+if (zh) {

+  const dictionary={
+    'Account Settings':'账户设置','My Account':'我的账户','Profile Details':'个人资料','Business Profile':'工作资料','Display name':'显示名称','Organization':'机构','Location':'地点','Email':'电子邮件','Edit email':'编辑邮箱','Notifications':'通知','My Notifications':'我的通知','Privacy':'隐私','Public profile':'公开个人资料','Save changes':'保存更改','Cancel':'取消','Switch theme':'切换主题','Business settings':'工作设置',
+    'Receive a weekly digest of research notes shared with your workspace.':'每周接收工作区共享研究笔记的摘要。',
+    'Weekly digest is enabled':'已开启每周摘要','Weekly digest is disabled':'已关闭每周摘要',
+    'Allow other members of this research workspace to find your profile. Your email remains private.':'允许研究工作区的其他成员找到你的个人资料。电子邮箱仍为私密信息。',

+  const walker=document.createTreeWalker(document.body,NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);

+--- Guide for persistent-toast-notifications ---
+# Creating Toast Notifications
+
+Toast notifications are transient status messages. Unlike menus, they should not close when a user interacts with other parts of the page. The popover="manual" state is ideal because it lacks "light-dismiss" behavior and allows multiple notifications to coexist.
+
+### Implementation Guidelines
+
+* **MANDATORY:** Use popover="manual" so the notification stays visible until explicitly closed or timed out by a script.
+* **DO** use a container to manage the stacking of multiple toasts. Since popovers in the Top Layer ignore parent z-index, you must position them individually or within a common layout group.
+* **DO** use sibling-index() to add margin between toast notifications so that items lower in the stack are visible.
+* **DO** provide an explicit "Close" button within the toast using popovertargetaction="hide".
+* **DO** use JavaScript for auto-dismissal timers (e.g., calling hidePopover() after 3000ms).
+* **DO** utilize transition-behavior: allow-discrete to animate the entry and exit from the Top Layer.
+
+### Fallback Strategies
+
+### Fallbacks & browser support for Popover
+
+Baseline status for Popover: Newly available. It's been Baseline since 2025-01-27.
+Supported by: Chrome 116 (Aug 2023), Edge 116 (Aug 2023), Firefox 125 (Apr 2024), Safari 17 (Sep 2023), and Safari iOS 18.3 (Jan 2025).
+
+The Popover API is mostly **progressive enhancement**, but its defining behaviors — top-layer promotion, light-dismiss, and `popovertarget` invocation — have no CSS-only equivalent. Older browsers need a polyfill, or a manual fallback if you would rather not ship one.
+
+**Polyfill:** To support the `popover` attribute in older browsers, conditionally load [`@oddbird/popover-polyfill`](https://github.com/oddbird/popover-polyfill). **MANDATORY:** Feature detect by checking for the `popover` property on `HTMLElement.prototype`, and load the polyfill **only** when native support is missing — do NOT load it unconditionally.
+
+With a bundler or import map:
+
+```js
+// MANDATORY: Feature detect 'popover' on HTMLElement.prototype.
+if (!("popover" in HTMLElement.prototype)) {
+  import("@oddbird/popover-polyfill");
+}
+```
+
+Without a bundler, import from a CDN inside a `<script type="module">`:
+
+```html
+<script type="module">
+  if (!("popover" in HTMLElement.prototype)) {
+    import("https://unpkg.com/@oddbird/popover-polyfill@latest/dist/popover.min.js");
+  }
+</script>
+```
+
+**Styling caveat:** The polyfill cannot define the real `:popover-open` pseudo-class, so it applies a `.\:popover-open` class instead. **MANDATORY:** Combine the two with `:is()` or `:where()`, otherwise browsers that lack `:popover-open` discard the entire rule:
+
+```css
+[popover]:is(:popover-open, .\:popover-open) {
+  display: block;
+}
+```
+
+Alternatively, for a legacy fallback without a polyfill, use `position: fixed` and manually calculate coordinates via `getBoundingClientRect()` or rely on default positioning with `inset: auto` if that's acceptable for the use case.
+
+#### sibling-index()
+
+* **Guidance:** If sibling-index() is not supported, use the `+` operator to add margin manually. I.e. `popover + popover { margin-top: 1rem }`
+
+#### anchor-positioning
+
+* **Guidance:** Use the [CSS Anchor Positioning Polyfill](https://github.com/oddbird/css-anchor-positioning). For a non-polyfill fallback, default the tooltip to a fixed position at the bottom of the viewport using `@supports not (anchor-name: --foo)`.
+
+#### transition-behavior
+
+* **Guidance:** If transition-behavior is not supported, use JavaScript to add animation via classes as the toast element transitions in and out."},{"sha":"0f4d2a2abb0424f87a3251e2409d18a4a1cc9e02","filename":"docs/evidence/v1.20.0/session-study/runs/T4-G-final-runtime-r1/artifacts/evidence/commands/takeover-003/command.json","status":"added","additions":26,"deletions":0,"changes":26,"blob_url":"https://github.com/D1ChangGeng/UI-Spec-Studio/blob/89cf94495dc1300dbb21c3f93e5972a2c67ab020/docs%2Fevidence%2Fv1.20.0%2Fsession-study%2Fruns%2FT4-G-final-runtime-r1%2Fartifacts%2Fevidence%2Fcommands%2Ftakeover-003%2Fcommand.json","raw_url":"https://github.com/D1ChangGeng/UI-Spec-Studio/raw/89cf94495dc1300dbb21c3f93e5972a2c67ab020/docs%2Fevidence%2Fv1.20.0%2Fsession-study%2Fruns%2FT4-G-final-runtime-r1%2Fartifacts%2Fevidence%2Fcommands%2Ftakeover-003%2Fcommand.json","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/D1ChangGeng/UI-Spec-Studio/contents/docs%2Fevidence%2Fv1.20.0%2Fsession-study%2Fruns%2FT4-G-final-runtime-r1%2Fartifacts%2Fevidence%2Fcommands%2Ftakeover-003%2Fcommand.json?ref=89cf94495dc1300dbb21c3f93e5972a2c67ab020","patch":"@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@

+  "payload": "# W18 — Tabler save-feedback integration completed\n\nThe Fieldnotes settings application now uses the selected Tabler action-bearing Toast for real browser-local save feedback. Pending, success, failure/retry and validation states are connected to the existing authoritative store. The implementation and final visual review are complete within the supplied scope and tested conditions.\n\n## Run the product\n\nFrom `/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w18/app`:\n\n```bash\npython3 -m http.server 4418 --bind 127.0.0.1\n```\n\nOpen [the light/English application](http://127.0.0.1:4418/?theme=light&lang=en) or [the dark/Chinese application](http://127.0.0.1:4418/?theme=dark&lang=zh). Add `&fail=once` on a new load to exercise the forced failure, or call `window.fieldnotes.setFailureMode(true)` before saving. No build or install is required. The inspection server is stopped at handover; the application remains runnable with this command.\n\n## What changed\n\n| Product file | Bounded change | Diff |\n|---|---|---|\n| `app/index.html` | Adopted the exact native toast shell in the prescribed utility container; kept the inline summary quiet to avoid a second live announcement | +19 / −1 lines |\n| `app/settings-controller.js` | Coordinates authoritative events, pending controls, field errors, draft-aware summary and visible focus recovery | +68 / −4 lines |\n| `app/save-notification.js` | New adapter for native Toast rendering, localized feedback, exact-snapshot retry, stale-event protection and dismissal focus | +69 lines |\n\nNo dependency or custom CSS rule was added. The store, source preview and 35 tracked protected source/asset files remain byte-identical. The existing MIT license and adopted-block attribution are retained. The exact final comparison is in [product-changes.diff](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w18/evidence/product-changes.diff).\n\nSuccess wording follows an actual successful storage write and displays its saved time. Failure preserves both the previous stored value and current form edits. Retry saves the failed submission's snapshot, while a later draft remains in the fields. Toast completion does not steal form focus. Close dismisses only the feedback, and a later authoritative event can replace it. Validation uses the store's actual errors and names the first invalid field in both languages.\n\n## Verification and the repair it prompted\n\nThe six required conditions—1440×900, 1280×600 and 390×844, each in light/English and dark/Chinese—passed 180 assertions covering save, pending edits, success, forced failure, retry, validation, close, storage readback, reload, theme controls, announcements and containment. A supplemental sequence verified that an older error cannot replace a newer invalid result and that dismissing pending feedback does not cancel the write.\n\nA later independent keyboard/visual check exposed a real issue missed by DOM-focus assertions: on a narrow screen the first invalid field could be focused at y=0 behind the toast. I repaired only the controller's recovery scrolling. All six conditions then passed fresh Tab traversal, dismissal return, invalid-field visibility and header-return checks, and I personally opened the repaired screenshots. The field now appears visibly centered below the toast. See [the failed observation](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w18/evidence/keyboard-final-02/light-en-settled-invalid.png) and [the repaired narrow view](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w18/evidence/keyboard-final-03/390x844-light-en-settled-invalid.png).\n\nThe corrected storage-exception probe confirms that an actual thrown storage write preserves the previous value, and retry succeeds after storage is restored without overwriting newer form edits. Persistent feedback remained visible beyond the native default timeout. Final JavaScript syntax and source digests passed.\n\nOriginal command failures are retained. The first broad command ended with a supplemental test-harness error after its six matrix cases had passed; the corrected probe is separate. A premature evidence-packaging attempt also failed while waiting for the subsequently repaired keyboard result. These failures are not relabeled as successful runs. [verification-summary.json](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w18/evidence/verification-summary.json) identifies the actual exports and their boundaries.\n\n## Source craft and visual findings\n\nThe integration retains the source's 350 px width, native type, header/body grouping, border, shadow, padding, small primary button and separated action row. English and Chinese states fit at the narrow width; the lower settings actions remain reachable. I personally inspected the supplied standalone source, the acquired original-page rendering, integrated whole-page views, source detail, ordered state frames and repaired validation views. [VISUAL-REVIEW.md](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w18/VISUAL-REVIEW.md) records the observations and their limits.\n\nRepresentative final views:\n\n- [Desktop, light/English error](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w18/evidence/final-inspection/1440x900-light-en-error-top.png)\n- [Short viewport, dark/Chinese with lower controls](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w18/evidence/final-inspection/1280x600-dark-zh-error-lower.png)\n- [Narrow viewport, dark/Chinese error](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w18/evidence/final-inspection/390x844-dark-zh-error-top.png)\n- [Repaired narrow Chinese validation](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w18/evidence/keyboard-final-03/390x844-dark-zh-settled-invalid.png)\n\n**The prescribed placement has a visible tradeoff:** while open, the toast overlaps some upper-right header utilities and much of the narrow header/title area. The native close control stays reachable, and dismissal restores the header. I preserved this settled composition and reported the overlap rather than choosing a new placement.\n\n## Evidence and limits\n\nThe three supplied HTML/block hashes match [SOURCE-MANIFEST.json](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w18/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json). I retained the failure and rendered the exact acquired upstream HTML locally with matching assets; this is not a claim of live public-site inspection. Temporal evidence consists of real-time automated actions and personally viewed, timestamped ordered frames. Natural-speed playback and actual screen-reader speech were not inspected. Unrelated upstream gallery routes remain outside the task contract.\n\nThis package was implemented directly, with no additional package child and no merge step. +# Fieldnotes settings: completed save-feedback integration
+
+The assigned T4 integration is complete. The existing settings application now uses the selected native Tabler toast for pending, saved, failed and invalid outcomes, with explicit retry of the failed snapshot and preserved newer edits.
+
+## Run the application
+
+No build or dependency installation is required.
+
+```bash
+cd /workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w17/app
+python3 -m http.server 4417 --bind 127.0.0.1
+```
+
+Open [the light English view](http://127.0.0.1:4417/?theme=light&lang=en) or [the dark Chinese view](http://127.0.0.1:4417/?theme=dark&lang=zh). Add `&fail=once` to exercise a one-time save failure and Retry. The dedicated verification server was stopped after testing, as required.
+
+## What changed
+
+| Product file | Result |
+| --- | --- |
+| [index.html](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w17/app/index.html) | Adopts the native action-bearing toast, its full MIT notice, the prescribed top-right container and associated Tabler field-error slots. |
+| [settings-controller.js](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w17/app/settings-controller.js) | Coordinates store events, concise form summaries, actual field errors, focus recovery and stale-result suppression. |
+| [save-notification.js](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w17/app/save-notification.js) | Renders the authoritative save states and retries the exact failed snapshot through the existing store. |
+
+A successful save reports the actual browser-local outcome and saved time. It leaves later edits in the form and marks those edits as unsaved. A failed write preserves the previous stored value and the draft. Retry saves the failed version explicitly. Dismissal changes only feedback; it does not cancel persistence or discard input. Invalid submissions identify the actual first invalid field and expose associated localized errors.
+
+The source's 350px shell, avatar/identity/time/close header, body spacing, separated error action, small primary button, typography, border, shadow and native Toast transitions remain intact. The frozen placement and source choice were retained. The [source manifest](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w17/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json) preserves Tabler 1.7.1, the tagged revision and the separate deployed HTML snapshot identity; the deployment commit remains unknown.

A separate reduced-motion run reached a saved result with the native toast transition measured at `0s`.

+# Main-agent visual review — Fieldnotes save feedback
+
+## Judgment and boundary
+
+The settled T4 save-feedback integration is complete within the assigned edit surface. I independently inspected the selected source before delegation, reviewed the actual code, exercised the integrated application, and personally opened the final assembled screenshots. The native Tabler visual relationships survive the integration. Source selection, placement and the surrounding page were inherited from INTEGRATION-DECISION.md; no new art direction or original-construction exception was introduced.
+
+This is main-agent design judgment for the bounded integration. It is not a claim of end-user aesthetic approval, a live screen-reader audit, real-device touch validation, or whole-gallery completion. Two visible limits remain below.
+
+## Conditions and subjects
+
+The actual browser was Chromium headless shell 143.0.7499.4 through local Python Playwright, with device scale factor 1 and the prescribed Noto CJK Fontconfig file. The evaluated combinations were 1440×900, 1280×600 and 390×844, each in light/en and dark/zh.
+
+I kept these subjects distinct:
+- The exact acquired official HTML, locally rendered and operated through its original Cookies toast trigger.
+- The supplied isolated source block rendering.
+- The unchanged prepared Fieldnotes settings page.
+- The actual integrated page and browser-local save flow.
+
+The public deployed source reports 1.7.1, while the related tagged source is revision `07f60c07da13d8ff957a370434b7ef5c86f5ab94`. The deployed snapshot's exact commit remains unknown. Original snapshots and their digests are preserved; the current live upstream page was used only as textual source context.
+
+## Whole surface, relationships and detail
+
+At 1440×900 the form retains its sidebar, account heading, profile controls and three-field row. At 1280×600 the shorter viewport requires ordinary document scrolling, and the fixed feedback remains available while the lower Save and Cancel controls are reached. At 390×844 the inherited one-column form and stacked settings navigation remain intact. Initial card, heading, display-name field and Save-button geometry exactly matched the captured baseline in all six combinations.
+
+The adopted toast retains the 350px source width, compact avatar/identity/time/close header, bordered body, subtle shadow and separated error action row. FN uses the source initials fallback; Fieldnotes supplies the identity. There is no new surface CSS. Error uses the native small primary action. Pending, success and invalid hide the action row, preserving the source body measure.
+
+English copy wraps into two lines for error and pending; Chinese copy also wraps without clipping. The dark view keeps the source's dark header/body distinction and visible thin separator. The native close target is reachable in every required viewport. Source and integrated computed width, type, radius, border, shadow and header/body padding matched in the integrator's explicit check; my own code and pixel review established that the preserved classes actually appear in the assembled product.
+
+Validation uses the existing Tabler field-error treatment. The first invalid display-name field is brought into view, visible messages remain next to the empty name and malformed email, and both languages name the first field in the notification. At the mobile viewport the invalid field remains below the fixed toast rather than being hidden by it.
+
+## Actual views opened by the main agent
+
+Original full image-tool responses are in `evidence/views/`; `evidence/viewed-images.json` provides the exact input paths and receipt identities.
+
+Source/baseline: `evidence/captures/source-1440.png`, `baseline-1440.png`, and `acquired-source-1440.png`.
+
+For **each** prefix below, I personally opened all three settled images in `evidence/integrator/004-settled/`: `-error-top.png`, `-error-actions.png`, and `-invalid.png`.

+
+I also personally opened the main run's pending, success and retry-pending captures for both 1440 variants; the first integration error/invalid captures; the two unchanged mobile baseline Save-edge images; and the reduced-motion success image.
+
+## Static, controlled and natural-time evidence
+
+The 18 final settled integrator images explicitly wait for the native `showing` class to clear and use instant scrolling. Their capture brackets, viewport, scroll position, state and focus are in `004-settled/captures.json`. These support static appearance and contextual placement judgments.
+
+The main run used the store's real 750 ms timer and actual UI controls. Ordered captures in `evidence/main-check-002/` have actual page-clock capture brackets in `report.json`. The first pending screenshots sampled the start of the native fade before the toast was visible; these are retained as early-time observations. Retry-pending captures show the existing visible toast update in place, its action row removed, and focus restored to the editable display-name field. Success captures show the saved-time header while the newer draft and its unsaved-form summary remain visible.
+
+These sampled images and executed natural-timer interactions do **not** establish uninterrupted natural-speed animation smoothness. Two actual WebM recordings are retained but were not viewed as continuous playback. No claim of natural-time playback inspection, device-wide frame delivery or user-perceived latency is made. The main report's event-history arrays reset on page reload; the executed assertions, capture brackets, actual storage readbacks and original command output remain the evidence for those checks.
+
+A separate reduced-motion run exercised failure → keyboard retry → actual saved result and measured a native toast transition duration of `0s`. The resulting dark/Chinese success image was personally viewed.
+
+## Verified behavior
+
+The main independent matrix passed **203 assertions**: six required conditions plus the older-result/dismiss-pending stress. All six had zero JavaScript page errors. The checks include real storage readback, retained newer drafts, retry of the failed snapshot, native close preserving storage, first-error focus, associated field messages, non-duplicating status semantics, reload persistence, initial layout retention and toast containment.
+
+The scoped integrator separately passed **156 assertions**, including extended length validation, no auto-hide after 5.2 seconds, and additional real concurrent-operation cases. That result supports its specified checks; it did not substitute for the main agent's independent run or pixel review.
+
+## Visible limits retained with evidence
+
+### Prescribed top-right placement overlays header utilities
+
+At desktop sizes, the notification covers the right notification, app, language and user menu controls. At 390px it also covers the center of the primary-navigation toggle and the logo/user region. The native close remains directly reachable. After native dismissal and returning to the top, every sampled header control's center is reachable again.
+
+This is the observable consequence of the exact settled placement. I retained that explicit design decision and recorded the tradeoff; I do not claim the underlying header remains simultaneously pointer-accessible while the toast is displayed. Changing placement would reopen the frozen decision.
+
+### Inherited mobile Customize/Save overlap
+
+At 390×844, when Save is aligned at the viewport bottom, the unchanged floating Customize button covers part of Save's right edge. I independently rendered the preserved baseline and integrated page in both languages. The Save rectangles and hit results were identical: its center is reachable; the sampled upper-right point is covered. Keyboard activation also passed.

+# W18 — Tabler save-feedback integration completed
+
+The Fieldnotes settings application now uses the selected Tabler action-bearing Toast for real browser-local save feedback. Pending, success, failure/retry and validation states are connected to the existing authoritative store. The implementation and final visual review are complete within the supplied scope and tested conditions.
+
+## Run the product
+
+From `/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w18/app`:
+
+```bash
+python3 -m http.server 4418 --bind 127.0.0.1
+```
+
+Open [the light/English application](http://127.0.0.1:4418/?theme=light&lang=en) or [the dark/Chinese application](http://127.0.0.1:4418/?theme=dark&lang=zh). Add `&fail=once` on a new load to exercise the forced failure, or call `window.fieldnotes.setFailureMode(true)` before saving. No build or install is required. The inspection server is stopped at handover; the application remains runnable with this command.
+
+## What changed
+
+| Product file | Bounded change | Diff |
+|---|---|---|
+| `app/index.html` | Adopted the exact native toast shell in the prescribed utility container; kept the inline summary quiet to avoid a second live announcement | +19 / −1 lines |
+| `app/settings-controller.js` | Coordinates authoritative events, pending controls, field errors, draft-aware summary and visible focus recovery | +68 / −4 lines |
+| `app/save-notification.js` | New adapter for native Toast rendering, localized feedback, exact-snapshot retry, stale-event protection and dismissal focus | +69 lines |
+
+No dependency or custom CSS rule was added. The store, source preview and 35 tracked protected source/asset files remain byte-identical. The existing MIT license and adopted-block attribution are retained. The exact final comparison is in [product-changes.diff](artifacts/evidence/product-changes.diff.txt).
+
+Success wording follows an actual successful storage write and displays its saved time. Failure preserves both the previous stored value and current form edits. Retry saves the failed submission's snapshot, while a later draft remains in the fields. Toast completion does not steal form focus. Close dismisses only the feedback, and a later authoritative event can replace it. Validation uses the store's actual errors and names the first invalid field in both languages.
+
+## Verification and the repair it prompted
+
+The six required conditions—1440×900, 1280×600 and 390×844, each in light/English and dark/Chinese—passed 180 assertions covering save, pending edits, success, forced failure, retry, validation, close, storage readback, reload, theme controls, announcements and containment. A supplemental sequence verified that an older error cannot replace a newer invalid result and that dismissing pending feedback does not cancel the write.
+
+A later independent keyboard/visual check exposed a real issue missed by DOM-focus assertions: on a narrow screen the first invalid field could be focused at y=0 behind the toast. I repaired only the controller's recovery scrolling. All six conditions then passed fresh Tab traversal, dismissal return, invalid-field visibility and header-return checks, and I personally opened the repaired screenshots. The field now appears visibly centered below the toast. See [the failed observation](artifacts/evidence/keyboard-final-02/light-en-settled-invalid.png) and [the repaired narrow view](artifacts/evidence/keyboard-final-03/390x844-light-en-settled-invalid.png).
+
+The corrected storage-exception probe confirms that an actual thrown storage write preserves the previous value, and retry succeeds after storage is restored without overwriting newer form edits. Persistent feedback remained visible beyond the native default timeout. Final JavaScript syntax and source digests passed.
+
+Original command failures are retained. The first broad command ended with a supplemental test-harness error after its six matrix cases had passed; the corrected probe is separate. A premature evidence-packaging attempt also failed while waiting for the subsequently repaired keyboard result. These failures are not relabeled as successful runs. [verification-summary.json](artifacts/evidence/verification-summary.json) identifies the actual exports and their boundaries.
+
+## Source craft and visual findings
+
+The integration retains the source's 350 px width, native type, header/body grouping, border, shadow, padding, small primary button and separated action row. English and Chinese states fit at the narrow width; the lower settings actions remain reachable. I personally inspected the supplied standalone source, the acquired original-page rendering, integrated whole-page views, source detail, ordered state frames and repaired validation views. [VISUAL-REVIEW.md](artifacts/VISUAL-REVIEW.md.txt) records the observations and their limits.

+# Visual review — W18 save feedback
+
+## Reviewer and scope
+
+The package owner personally opened the source, trial, final and repaired images using `view_image`; the original returned objects are preserved in `evidence/views/` and `evidence/source-inspection/view-*.json`. `evidence/viewed-images.json` indexes the actual viewed images. This report is professional judgment, not a native tool export or end-user aesthetic acceptance.
+
+The retained source is Tabler 1.7.1's action-bearing cookie Toast. Source identity and composition were settled by the supplied integration decision; no new resource choice or original visual exception was made. The primary task is editing and persisting browser-local settings with truthful feedback and recovery.
+
+## Source observations
+
+I read the exact extracted block and tagged Astro component, then viewed the supplied standalone source rendering in light and dark. I also operated the original Cookies toast trigger in the exact acquired full deployed HTML, rendered locally with the matching supplied assets. Its full-page image includes the entrance transition; the separately viewed toast crop is settled. This is distinct from the integrated settings application.
+
+The live public demo failed certificate verification (`ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID`); TLS checks were not weakened. The original deployed snapshot was fulfilled at a local test route, with nonlocal requests blocked. The unavailable sample portrait and cookie glyph are limitations of that source rendering, not assets shipped in the integration. The product uses the authorized FN initials fallback and no emoji.
+
+The source's value is a compact 350 px shell with a quiet identity/time/close header, readable body, and a fine separator above one small primary action. The integrated error state retains those relationships. Native computed values include 14 px body type, 20 px line height, 8×12 px header padding, 12 px body padding, 8 px action margin/padding, 6 px corner radius and the existing border/shadow. They are inherited from the unchanged assets, not replacement CSS.
+
+## Whole-product observations
+
+| Condition | Actually viewed relationship | Judgment |
+|---|---|---|
+| 1440×900, light/English and dark/Chinese | Initial composition, error toast, source detail, pending and success samples, repaired invalid state | The toast remains a compact secondary surface. The main settings hierarchy, mixed-script values, sidebar and form grouping remain intact. |
+| 1280×600, both declared variants | Error at the top and lower document position; repaired invalid states | Short height requires the inherited document scroll. Retry and close remain visible, while the lower Save/Cancel row remains unobstructed. |
+| 390×844, both declared variants | Error at top and lower positions; Chinese success; repaired invalid states; restored headers | The 350 px toast fits within the viewport at x=24…374. English and Chinese copy wrap naturally; action text and close stay within the surface. No horizontal page overflow was measured. |
+
+The prescribed top-right placement overlaps some upstream header utilities while feedback is visible; at narrow size it covers much of the header/title area. This is an observed consequence of the fixed integration decision. The native Close control remains exposed, and the restored-header views show the navigation unobscured after dismissal. I preserved the mandated placement rather than changing art direction. Settings controls and lower save actions remain usable by scrolling.
+
+## A real defect found after functional checks
+
+The first matrix verified that invalid submission moved DOM focus to Display name, but a subsequent settled narrow screenshot showed that the field was at y=0, underneath the fixed toast. This was a visible-focus defect, not a passing visual result. The failed screenshot and geometry remain in `evidence/keyboard-final-02`, and commands 011/013 retain the failed assertions.
+
+The allowed controller now uses native `scrollIntoView({block:'center', behavior:'instant'})`, then focuses with `preventScroll`. The final keyboard recheck covers all six declared conditions. The focused field now sits at y=430 at 1440×900, y=280 at 1280×600, and y=402 at 390×844, below the toast. I personally viewed all six repaired invalid-state images and the two restored narrow headers. The field label, input boundary and localized error are visible together. No source CSS, toast transition, placement or store rule changed.
+
+The real Tab sequence from Save reaches Close and Retry in nine Tab steps through the existing footer controls. Shift+Tab returns from Retry to Close; Enter dismisses; focus returns to Save. These were executed in all six final conditions, separately from programmatic focus checks.
+
+## Time, focus and state
+
+I viewed ordered pending/edit/error/retry/success samples and the later measured entrance/result frames. `evidence/temporal-01` records browser `performance.now()` brackets, native Toast events and actual operation events. Frame filename offsets are requested targets; JSON timestamps are the actual capture times. For example, the English file labelled 0400 ms was captured at approximately 617 ms because of capture overhead.
+
+Early entrance frames have the native `showing` class and opacity 0, followed by the source fade. Later pending frames are fully readable before authoritative success. The inline summary acknowledges the operation immediately. Pending and success retain the same compact height, and the lower form action remains anchored. Native focus styling remains visible on Save while its disabled presentation changes. Error adds the inherited separated action row; retry removes that row and returns focus to Save. Editing during pending and success retains the newer draft.
+
+These are real-time automated interactions plus actually viewed ordered frames, with unobserved intervals between samples. No natural-speed live or video playback was viewed, and no smoothness, frame-rate or screen-reader speech claim is made. ARIA ownership and field associations were checked structurally; actual assistive-technology output remains untested.
+
+## Current evidence applicability
+
+The broad save/retry matrix and the source/error/success views precede the narrow recovery-scroll repair. Their state, persistence, source and appearance claims remain applicable because the final delta changes only invalid-field recovery scrolling. All affected invalid-focus, keyboard and restored-header conditions were freshly rerun and viewed after that delta. Final source hashes, protected-file hashes and JavaScript syntax were rechecked after the repair.
