+# Visual review — W18 save feedback
+
+## Reviewer and scope
+
+The package owner personally opened the source, trial, final and repaired images using `view_image`; the original returned objects are preserved in `evidence/views/` and `evidence/source-inspection/view-*.json`. `evidence/viewed-images.json` indexes the actual viewed images. This report is professional judgment, not a native tool export or end-user aesthetic acceptance.
+
+The retained source is Tabler 1.7.1's action-bearing cookie Toast. Source identity and composition were settled by the supplied integration decision; no new resource choice or original visual exception was made. The primary task is editing and persisting browser-local settings with truthful feedback and recovery.
+
+## Source observations
+
+I read the exact extracted block and tagged Astro component, then viewed the supplied standalone source rendering in light and dark. I also operated the original Cookies toast trigger in the exact acquired full deployed HTML, rendered locally with the matching supplied assets. Its full-page image includes the entrance transition; the separately viewed toast crop is settled. This is distinct from the integrated settings application.
+
+The live public demo failed certificate verification (`ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID`); TLS checks were not weakened. The original deployed snapshot was fulfilled at a local test route, with nonlocal requests blocked. The unavailable sample portrait and cookie glyph are limitations of that source rendering, not assets shipped in the integration. The product uses the authorized FN initials fallback and no emoji.
+
+The source's value is a compact 350 px shell with a quiet identity/time/close header, readable body, and a fine separator above one small primary action. The integrated error state retains those relationships. Native computed values include 14 px body type, 20 px line height, 8×12 px header padding, 12 px body padding, 8 px action margin/padding, 6 px corner radius and the existing border/shadow. They are inherited from the unchanged assets, not replacement CSS.
+
+## Whole-product observations
+
+| Condition | Actually viewed relationship | Judgment |
+|---|---|---|
+| 1440×900, light/English and dark/Chinese | Initial composition, error toast, source detail, pending and success samples, repaired invalid state | The toast remains a compact secondary surface. The main settings hierarchy, mixed-script values, sidebar and form grouping remain intact. |
+| 1280×600, both declared variants | Error at the top and lower document position; repaired invalid states | Short height requires the inherited document scroll. Retry and close remain visible, while the lower Save/Cancel row remains unobstructed. |
+| 390×844, both declared variants | Error at top and lower positions; Chinese success; repaired invalid states; restored headers | The 350 px toast fits within the viewport at x=24…374. English and Chinese copy wrap naturally; action text and close stay within the surface. No horizontal page overflow was measured. |
+
+The prescribed top-right placement overlaps some upstream header utilities while feedback is visible; at narrow size it covers much of the header/title area. This is an observed consequence of the fixed integration decision. The native Close control remains exposed, and the restored-header views show the navigation unobscured after dismissal. I preserved the mandated placement rather than changing art direction. Settings controls and lower save actions remain usable by scrolling.
+
+## A real defect found after functional checks
+
+The first matrix verified that invalid submission moved DOM focus to Display name, but a subsequent settled narrow screenshot showed that the field was at y=0, underneath the fixed toast. This was a visible-focus defect, not a passing visual result. The failed screenshot and geometry remain in `evidence/keyboard-final-02`, and commands 011/013 retain the failed assertions.
+
+The allowed controller now uses native `scrollIntoView({block:'center', behavior:'instant'})`, then focuses with `preventScroll`. The final keyboard recheck covers all six declared conditions. The focused field now sits at y=430 at 1440×900, y=280 at 1280×600, and y=402 at 390×844, below the toast. I personally viewed all six repaired invalid-state images and the two restored narrow headers. The field label, input boundary and localized error are visible together. No source CSS, toast transition, placement or store rule changed.
+
+The real Tab sequence from Save reaches Close and Retry in nine Tab steps through the existing footer controls. Shift+Tab returns from Retry to Close; Enter dismisses; focus returns to Save. These were executed in all six final conditions, separately from programmatic focus checks.
+
+## Time, focus and state
+
+I viewed ordered pending/edit/error/retry/success samples and the later measured entrance/result frames. `evidence/temporal-01` records browser `performance.now()` brackets, native Toast events and actual operation events. Frame filename offsets are requested targets; JSON timestamps are the actual capture times. For example, the English file labelled 0400 ms was captured at approximately 617 ms because of capture overhead.
+
+Early entrance frames have the native `showing` class and opacity 0, followed by the source fade. Later pending frames are fully readable before authoritative success. The inline summary acknowledges the operation immediately. Pending and success retain the same compact height, and the lower form action remains anchored. Native focus styling remains visible on Save while its disabled presentation changes. Error adds the inherited separated action row; retry removes that row and returns focus to Save. Editing during pending and success retains the newer draft.
+
+These are real-time automated interactions plus actually viewed ordered frames, with unobserved intervals between samples. No natural-speed live or video playback was viewed, and no smoothness, frame-rate or screen-reader speech claim is made. ARIA ownership and field associations were checked structurally; actual assistive-technology output remains untested.
+
+## Current evidence applicability
+
+The broad save/retry matrix and the source/error/success views precede the narrow recovery-scroll repair. Their state, persistence, source and appearance claims remain applicable because the final delta changes only invalid-field recovery scrolling. All affected invalid-focus, keyboard and restored-header conditions were freshly rerun and viewed after that delta. Final source hashes, protected-file hashes and JavaScript syntax were rechecked after the repair.
+

+// Tabler 1.7.1 action-toast integration. The source shell is in index.html.
+// Tabler copyright (c) 2018-2026 The Tabler Authors, MIT; see LICENSE.
+import { saveSettings } from './settings-store.js';
+
+export function createSaveNotification({ zh, returnFocus, fieldName }) {
+  const root = document.querySelector('#save-notification');
+  const message = document.querySelector('#save-notification-message');
+  const time = document.querySelector('#save-notification-time');
+  const actions = document.querySelector('#save-notification-actions');
+  const retry = document.querySelector('#retry-save');
+  const close = root.querySelector('[data-bs-dismiss="toast"]');
+  const toast = window.tabler.bootstrap.Toast.getOrCreateInstance(root, { autohide: false });
+  const formatTime = value => new Intl.DateTimeFormat(zh ? 'zh-CN' : 'en', {hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit',second:'2-digit'}).format(new Date(value));
+  let latestOperation = 0;
+  let failedSnapshot = null;
+  let hiding = false;
+  let reopen = false;
+  let restoreAfterHide = false;
+  close.setAttribute('aria-label', zh ? '关闭保存提示' : 'Close save feedback');
+  retry.textContent = zh ? '重试保存' : 'Retry save';
+
+  root.addEventListener('hide.bs.toast', () => {
+    hiding = true;
+    restoreAfterHide = root.contains(document.activeElement);
+  });
+  root.addEventListener('hidden.bs.toast', () => {
+    hiding = false;
+    if (restoreAfterHide && (root.contains(document.activeElement) || document.activeElement === document.body)) returnFocus();
+    restoreAfterHide = false;
+    if (reopen) { reopen = false; toast.show(); }
+  });
+  retry.addEventListener('click', () => {
+    if (!failedSnapshot) return;
+    // Retry exactly the submitted snapshot. Later form edits remain owned by the form.
+    const snapshot = { ...failedSnapshot };
+    saveSettings(snapshot).catch(() => {});
+  });
+
+  return {
+    render(event) {
+      if (event.operationId < latestOperation) return;
+      latestOperation = event.operationId;
+      const isError = event.status === 'error';
+      if (!isError && actions.contains(document.activeElement)) returnFocus();
+      failedSnapshot = isError ? { ...event.snapshot } : null;
+      actions.hidden = !isError;
+      root.dataset.state = event.status;
+      root.dataset.operationId = String(event.operationId);
+      time.textContent = event.savedAt ? formatTime(event.savedAt) : (zh ? '刚刚' : 'Now');
+      if (event.savedAt) time.setAttribute('title', event.savedAt); else time.removeAttribute('title');
+      const firstField = Object.keys(event.fieldErrors || {})[0];
+      const content = zh ? {
+        pending: '正在保存更改。正在将本次提交的版本保存到当前浏览器。',
+        success: '更改已保存。本次提交的版本仅保存在当前浏览器中。',
+        error: '保存未完成。草稿仍然保留。重试将保存上次提交的版本。',
+        invalid: `请检查个人资料字段：${fieldName(firstField)}。`
+      } : {
+        pending: 'Saving changes. Saving the submitted version in this browser.',
+        success: 'Changes saved. The submitted version is saved only in this browser.',
+        error: 'Save did not complete. Your draft is preserved. Retry saves the previously submitted version.',
+        invalid: `Check profile fields: ${fieldName(firstField)}.`
+      };
+      message.textContent = content[event.status];
+      if (hiding) reopen = true;
+      else if (!root.classList.contains('show')) toast.show();
+    },
+    formatTime
+  };
+}"},{"sha":"f9b728f3fd5d6bcdd8e0428067bb783608ea3ab4","filename":"docs/evidence/v1.20.0/session-study/runs/T4-G-final-runtime-r1/artifacts/app/settings-controller.js","status":"added","additions":97,"deletions":0,"changes":97,"blob_url":"https://github.com/D1ChangGeng/UI-Spec-Studio/blob/89cf94495dc1300dbb21c3f93e5972a2c67ab020/docs%2Fevidence%2Fv1.20.0%2Fsession-study%2Fruns%2FT4-G-final-runtime-r1%2Fartifacts%2Fapp%2Fsettings-controller.js","raw_url":"https://github.com/D1ChangGeng/UI-Spec-Studio/raw/89cf94495dc1300dbb21c3f93e5972a2c67ab020/docs%2Fevidence%2Fv1.20.0%2Fsession-study%2Fruns%2FT4-G-final-runtime-r1%2Fartifacts%2Fapp%2Fsettings-controller.js","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/D1ChangGeng/UI-Spec-Studio/contents/docs%2Fevidence%2Fv1.20.0%2Fsession-study%2Fruns%2FT4-G-final-runtime-r1%2Fartifacts%2Fapp%2Fsettings-controller.js?ref=89cf94495dc1300dbb21c3f93e5972a2c67ab020","patch":"@@ -0,0 +1,97 @@
+import { readSettings, saveSettings, subscribeSettings, setFailureMode } from './settings-store.js';

+const ids = {displayName:'business-name',organization:'business-id',location:'location',email:'email',weeklyDigest:'weekly-digest',publicProfile:'public-profile'};
+const status = document.querySelector('#save-status');

+const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);

+const copy = zh ? {idle:'更改仅保存在当前浏览器中。',pending:'本次提交正在保存。',error:'未写入本次提交的版本。',invalid:'请修正已标出的字段。'} : {idle:'Changes are saved only in this browser.',pending:'The submitted version is being saved.',error:'The submitted version was not written.',invalid:'Correct the marked fields.'};
+const names = zh ? {displayName:'显示名称',organization:'机构',location:'地点',email:'电子邮件'} : {displayName:'Display name',organization:'Organization',location:'Location',email:'Email'};

+let latestOperation = 0;
+let pending = false;
+let initiatingControl = save;
+function draft() { return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(ids).map(([key,id])=>{const el=document.getElementById(id);return [key,el.type==='checkbox'?el.checked:el.value];})); }
+function clearErrors() {
+  for (const id of Object.values(ids)) {
+    const field = document.getElementById(id);
+    field.classList.remove('is-invalid');
+    field.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
+    const described = (field.getAttribute('aria-describedby') || '').split(/\s+/).filter(value => value && value !== `${id}-error`);
+    if (described.length) field.setAttribute('aria-describedby', described.join(' ')); else field.removeAttribute('aria-describedby');
+    document.getElementById(`${id}-error`)?.remove();
+  }
+}
+function showErrors(fieldErrors) {
+  clearErrors();
+  for (const [key, message] of Object.entries(fieldErrors)) {
+    const field = document.getElementById(ids[key]);
+    if (!field) continue;
+    const feedback = document.createElement('div');
+    feedback.id = `${field.id}-error`;
+    feedback.className = 'invalid-feedback';
+    feedback.textContent = zh ? (errorsZh[message] || message) : message;

+    // Native focus scrolling can leave a narrow-screen field behind the fixed toast.
+    // Center the recovery target while retaining Tabler's field and toast styling.
+    first.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center', behavior: 'instant' });
+    if (document.activeElement !== first) first.focus({ preventScroll: true });
+  }
+}
+function load() { const data=readSettings(); for(const [key,id] of Object.entries(ids)){const el=document.getElementById(id); if(el.type==='checkbox')el.checked=data[key];else el.value=data[key];} }
+function returnFocus() {
+  const target = initiatingControl?.isConnected && !initiatingControl.disabled ? initiatingControl : save;
+  target.focus();
+}
+const notification = createSaveNotification({zh, returnFocus, fieldName: key => names[key] || (zh ? '个人资料' : 'Profile')});
+try { load(); status.textContent=copy.idle; } catch(error) { status.textContent=error.message; }
+subscribeSettings(event => {
+  if (event.operationId < latestOperation) return;
+  latestOperation = event.operationId;
+  pending = event.status === 'pending';
+  // Native Tabler disabled styling plus aria-disabled keeps keyboard focus stable.
+  save.classList.toggle('disabled', pending);

+  if (event.status === 'invalid') showErrors(event.fieldErrors);
+  else if (event.status === 'pending') clearErrors();

+    const changed = Object.keys(ids).some(key => draft()[key] !== event.settings[key]);
+    const savedTime = notification.formatTime(event.savedAt);
+    status.textContent = zh ? `上次保存：${savedTime}。${changed ? '之后的编辑尚未保存。' : ''}` : `Last saved: ${savedTime}.${changed ? ' Later edits are not saved yet.' : ''}`;
+  } else status.textContent = copy[event.status] || copy.idle;
+  status.dataset.state = event.status;
+  notification.render(event);
+});
+save.addEventListener('click', async () => {
+  if (pending) return;
+  initiatingControl = save;
+  try { await saveSettings(draft()); } catch {}
+});
+document.querySelector('#cancel-settings').addEventListener('click',()=>{try{load();clearErrors();status.textContent=copy.idle;status.dataset.state='idle';}catch(error){status.textContent=error.message;}});
+document.querySelector('#focus-email').addEventListener('click',()=>document.querySelector('#email').focus());

+document.querySelector('#theme-toggle').addEventListener('click',()=>{const dark=document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-bs-theme')==='dark';document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-bs-theme',dark?'light':'dark');localStorage.setItem('tabler-theme',dark?'light':'dark');});
+window.fieldnotes = { readSettings, saveSettings, setFailureMode, draft };
+if (zh) {

+  const dictionary={
+    'Account Settings':'账户设置','My Account':'我的账户','Profile Details':'个人资料','Business Profile':'工作资料','Display name':'显示名称','Organization':'机构','Location':'地点','Email':'电子邮件','Edit email':'编辑邮箱','Notifications':'通知','My Notifications':'我的通知','Privacy':'隐私','Public profile':'公开个人资料','Save changes':'保存更改','Cancel':'取消','Switch theme':'切换主题','Business settings':'工作设置',
+    'Receive a weekly digest of research notes shared with your workspace.':'每周接收工作区共享研究笔记的摘要。',
+    'Weekly digest is enabled':'已开启每周摘要','Weekly digest is disabled':'已关闭每周摘要',
+    'Allow other members of this research workspace to find your profile. Your email remains private.':'允许研究工作区的其他成员找到你的个人资料。电子邮箱仍为私密信息。',

+  const walker=document.createTreeWalker(document.body,NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);

+--- Guide for persistent-toast-notifications ---
+# Creating Toast Notifications
+
+Toast notifications are transient status messages. Unlike menus, they should not close when a user interacts with other parts of the page. The popover="manual" state is ideal because it lacks "light-dismiss" behavior and allows multiple notifications to coexist.
+
+### Implementation Guidelines
+
+* **MANDATORY:** Use popover="manual" so the notification stays visible until explicitly closed or timed out by a script.
+* **DO** use a container to manage the stacking of multiple toasts. Since popovers in the Top Layer ignore parent z-index, you must position them individually or within a common layout group.
+* **DO** use sibling-index() to add margin between toast notifications so that items lower in the stack are visible.
+* **DO** provide an explicit "Close" button within the toast using popovertargetaction="hide".
+* **DO** use JavaScript for auto-dismissal timers (e.g., calling hidePopover() after 3000ms).
+* **DO** utilize transition-behavior: allow-discrete to animate the entry and exit from the Top Layer.
+
+### Fallback Strategies
+
+### Fallbacks & browser support for Popover
+
+Baseline status for Popover: Newly available. It's been Baseline since 2025-01-27.
+Supported by: Chrome 116 (Aug 2023), Edge 116 (Aug 2023), Firefox 125 (Apr 2024), Safari 17 (Sep 2023), and Safari iOS 18.3 (Jan 2025).
+
+The Popover API is mostly **progressive enhancement**, but its defining behaviors — top-layer promotion, light-dismiss, and `popovertarget` invocation — have no CSS-only equivalent. Older browsers need a polyfill, or a manual fallback if you would rather not ship one.
+
+**Polyfill:** To support the `popover` attribute in older browsers, conditionally load [`@oddbird/popover-polyfill`](https://github.com/oddbird/popover-polyfill). **MANDATORY:** Feature detect by checking for the `popover` property on `HTMLElement.prototype`, and load the polyfill **only** when native support is missing — do NOT load it unconditionally.
+
+With a bundler or import map:
+
+```js
+// MANDATORY: Feature detect 'popover' on HTMLElement.prototype.
+if (!("popover" in HTMLElement.prototype)) {
+  import("@oddbird/popover-polyfill");
+}
+```
+
+Without a bundler, import from a CDN inside a `<script type="module">`:
+
+```html
+<script type="module">
+  if (!("popover" in HTMLElement.prototype)) {
+    import("https://unpkg.com/@oddbird/popover-polyfill@latest/dist/popover.min.js");
+  }
+</script>
+```
+
+**Styling caveat:** The polyfill cannot define the real `:popover-open` pseudo-class, so it applies a `.\:popover-open` class instead. **MANDATORY:** Combine the two with `:is()` or `:where()`, otherwise browsers that lack `:popover-open` discard the entire rule:
+
+```css
+[popover]:is(:popover-open, .\:popover-open) {
+  display: block;
+}
+```
+
+Alternatively, for a legacy fallback without a polyfill, use `position: fixed` and manually calculate coordinates via `getBoundingClientRect()` or rely on default positioning with `inset: auto` if that's acceptable for the use case.
+
+#### sibling-index()
+
+* **Guidance:** If sibling-index() is not supported, use the `+` operator to add margin manually. I.e. `popover + popover { margin-top: 1rem }`
+
+#### anchor-positioning
+
+* **Guidance:** Use the [CSS Anchor Positioning Polyfill](https://github.com/oddbird/css-anchor-positioning). For a non-polyfill fallback, default the tooltip to a fixed position at the bottom of the viewport using `@supports not (anchor-name: --foo)`.
+
+#### transition-behavior
+
+* **Guidance:** If transition-behavior is not supported, use JavaScript to add animation via classes as the toast element transitions in and out."},{"sha":"0f4d2a2abb0424f87a3251e2409d18a4a1cc9e02","filename":"docs/evidence/v1.20.0/session-study/runs/T4-G-final-runtime-r1/artifacts/evidence/commands/takeover-003/command.json","status":"added","additions":26,"deletions":0,"changes":26,"blob_url":"https://github.com/D1ChangGeng/UI-Spec-Studio/blob/89cf94495dc1300dbb21c3f93e5972a2c67ab020/docs%2Fevidence%2Fv1.20.0%2Fsession-study%2Fruns%2FT4-G-final-runtime-r1%2Fartifacts%2Fevidence%2Fcommands%2Ftakeover-003%2Fcommand.json","raw_url":"https://github.com/D1ChangGeng/UI-Spec-Studio/raw/89cf94495dc1300dbb21c3f93e5972a2c67ab020/docs%2Fevidence%2Fv1.20.0%2Fsession-study%2Fruns%2FT4-G-final-runtime-r1%2Fartifacts%2Fevidence%2Fcommands%2Ftakeover-003%2Fcommand.json","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/D1ChangGeng/UI-Spec-Studio/contents/docs%2Fevidence%2Fv1.20.0%2Fsession-study%2Fruns%2FT4-G-final-runtime-r1%2Fartifacts%2Fevidence%2Fcommands%2Ftakeover-003%2Fcommand.json?ref=89cf94495dc1300dbb21c3f93e5972a2c67ab020","patch":"@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
